attr.title: Rusty (PC-98)
attr.desc: Native Rusty PC-98 recompilation for RG35XX-H / KNULLI using the SDL3 SDL2-backend shim.
attr.inst: Rusty.sh installs in ports/. All Rusty files are contained in ports/rusty/. Copy your own disk image, FONT.ROM and ym2608_adpcm_rom.bin into ports/rusty/roms/. Only one disk image should be present.
